name: artisan-oven-v2
description: One-word wrappers around the Docker Compose stacks (see CLAUDE.md → Commands).

scripts.dev: docker compose -p ao-dev -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.dev:up: docker compose -p ao-dev -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up --build -d
scripts.dev:restart: docker compose -p ao-dev -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml restart api
scripts.dev:down: docker compose -p ao-dev -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml down
scripts.reset-db: docker compose -p ao-dev -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && npm run dev:up
scripts.test: docker compose -p ao-dev -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm -T api npm test
scripts.logs: docker compose -p ao-dev -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f api
scripts.prod:up: docker compose -p ao-prod -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml up --build -d
scripts.prod:down: docker compose -p ao-prod -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml down
scripts.prod:logs: docker compose -p ao-prod -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f api
scripts.prod:ps: docker compose -p ao-prod -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml ps
